steps.title: Pick up tips on both pipettes
steps.instruction: Using both P1000 pipettes, attach a 1000 µL tip to each.

steps.title: Aspirate 700 µL with air gap
steps.instruction: Aspirate 700 µL from each source tube using an air gap.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 1 aspirates 700 µL from tube at position 1, rack 1, with air gap.
Pipette 2 aspirates 700 µL from tube at position 2, rack 1, with air gap.

steps.title: Dispense into dilution tubes
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated volume into the corresponding dilution tubes.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 1 dispenses the full 700 µL into tube at position 1, rack 3.
Pipette 2 dispenses the full 700 µL into tube at position 2, rack 3.
Pipette 1 mixes using 1000 µL volume, repeating 5 times.
Pipette 2 mixes using 1000 µL volume, repeating 5 times.

steps.title: Aspirate 800 µL from dilutions
steps.instruction: Aspirate 800 µL from each mixed dilution tube.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 1 aspirates 800 µL from its mixed dilution tube.
Pipette 2 aspirates 800 µL from its mixed dilution tube.

steps.title: Dispense into HPLC vials
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated volume into the designated HPLC vials.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 1 dispenses the full volume into vial at position 1 on the HPLC rack (deck position 11).
Pipette 2 dispenses the full volume into vial at position 2 on the HPLC rack (deck position 11).

steps.title: Discard used tips
steps.instruction: Eject both pipette tips into the waste tray.

steps.title: Repeat for each sample
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 1‑7 for each sample; pause to refill tips if processing more than 48 samples.
